snippet.title: Gamble With Your Friends IS OUT NOW ON STEAM
snippet.description:
STEAM : 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3892270/Gamble_With_Your_Friends/

👉 Follow for updates & fun vids
👉 Join discord discord.gg/THsmGmN5Ed

Gamble with Your Friends is world's first online co-op "casino crawler" where you and your friends gamble together to take down an evil gambling empire with a shared bank account!

You bunch of worthless degenerates
I Gave you a nice place to stay
A sweet ride to the place
With EVERYTHING to help you win
But you kept screwing up.
You went big when you should have went small
You went small when you should have went big
You kept betting on the wrong horse
Kept hitting when you should have stayed
Letting it ride when you should have let it slide.
So now we're here, at the end of the line.
Do you want another chance?
Let's see who deserves it then
